name: fastapi_documented
description: Positive control. Six endpoints, every one of them documented in docs/api.md with an explicit method+path, parameters, returns, errors and an example. DocZot should credit all six as covered; anything it reports as a gap here is a false positive.
notes: All 6 operations are documented, so operation coverage is exactly 100%. The band previously started at 85 to leave room for concept topics the docs do not spell out; that allowance is no longer needed because the figure now counts operations only.
